top_signals.title: Yen Surrenders Nearly Half Its Gains From US-Japan Intervention
top_signals.summary: The yen is heading into the end of the week having surrendered nearly half of its intervention-driven gains, fueling speculation among traders that authorities may step into the market again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nagasaki 81 years on: Learn what hibakusha know
top_signals.summary: The danger is that, as the generation that lived through the tragedies of World War II passes, it takes with it the firsthand experience of that war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
